items.source: The registered callbacks are overwritten and subsequently cleared when calling any of the create methods (such as create()), or any Factory newInstance method. Otherwise they are not cleared, and you should be careful to set them back to null after creating new instances via reflection if memory leakage is a concern.
items.translation: 已注册的回调在调用任何 `create` 方法（例如create()）或任何 Factory 的 `newInstance` 方法时会被覆盖并随后清除。否则，它们不会被清除，如果您担心内存泄漏问题，在通过反射创建新实例后，应小心地将它们重置为 `null`。

items.source: Although MethodInterceptor is generic enough to meet any interception need, it is often overkill. For simplicity and performance, additional specialized callback types, such as LazyLoader are also available. Often a single callback will be used per enhanced class, but you can control which callback is used on a per-method basis with a CallbackFilter.
items.translation: 尽管 `MethodInterceptor` 足够通用，可以满足任何拦截需求，但它往往显得过于复杂。为了简化操作并提高性能，还提供了其他专门的回调类型，例如 LazyLoader。通常每个增强类会使用一个回调，但您可以通过 CallbackFilter 按方法级别控制使用哪个回调。

items.source: All enhanced objects implement the Factory interface, unless setUseFactory(boolean) is used to explicitly disable this feature. The Factory interface provides an API to change the callbacks of an existing object, as well as a faster and easier way to create new instances of the same type.
items.translation: 所有增强对象都实现了Factory接口，除非使用setUseFactory(boolean)显式禁用此功能。Factory接口提供了一个 API，用于更改现有对象的回调，同时也提供了一种更快、更简便的方式来创建相同类型的新实例。

items.source: For an almost drop-in replacement for java.lang.reflect.Proxy, see the Proxy class.
items.translation: 对于几乎可以无缝替换`java.lang.reflect.Proxy`的情况，请参阅Proxy类。

items.source: The original and most general callback type is the MethodInterceptor, which in AOP terms enables "around advice"--that is, you can invoke custom code both before and after the invocation of the "super" method. In addition you can modify the arguments before calling the super method, or not call it at all.
items.translation: 最通用且原始的回调类型是 MethodInterceptor，在 AOP 术语中，它支持“环绕通知”（around advice）——即您可以在调用“父”方法之前和之后执行自定义代码。此外，您还可以在调用父方法之前修改参数，或者根本不调用该方法。

items.source: The most common uses of this class are embodied in the static helper methods. For advanced needs, such as customizing the ClassLoader to use, you should create a new instance of Enhancer. Other classes within CGLIB follow a similar pattern.
items.translation: 该类最常见的用途体现在静态辅助方法中。对于高级需求，例如自定义要使用的 `ClassLoader`，您应该创建一个新的 `Enhancer` 实例。CGLIB 中的其他类遵循类似的模式。

items.source: Note that this method only registers the callbacks on the current thread. If you want to register callbacks for instances created by multiple threads, use registerStaticCallbacks(Class, Callback[]).
items.translation: 注意，此方法仅在当前线程上注册回调。如果您想为多个线程创建的实例注册回调，请使用registerStaticCallbacks(Class, Callback[])。

items.source: Set the single type of Callback to use. This may be used instead of setCallback(Callback) when calling createClass(), since it may not be possible to have an array of actual callback instances.
items.translation: 设置要使用的 Callback 单类型。 在调用 createClass() 时，这可以替代 setCallback(Callback)，因为可能无法拥有实际回调实例的数组。

items.source: Set the array of callback types to use. This may be used instead of setCallbacks(Callback[]) when calling createClass(), since it may not be possible to have an array of actual callback instances. You must use a CallbackFilter to specify the index into this array for each method in the proxied class.
items.translation: 设置要使用的回调类型数组。 在调用createClass()时，这可以替代setCallbacks(Callback[])使用，因为可能无法拥有实际回调实例的数组。 您必须使用一个CallbackFilter来指定代理类中每个方法在该数组中的索引。

items.source: Set the single Callback to use. Ignored if you use createClass().
items.translation: 设置要使用的单个Callback。如果使用createClass()，则会被忽略。

items.source: Set the array of callbacks to use. Ignored if you use createClass(). You must use a CallbackFilter to specify the index into this array for each method in the proxied class.
items.translation: 设置要使用的回调数组。 如果您使用 createClass()，则会被忽略。 您必须使用一个 CallbackFilter 来指定代理类中每个方法在此数组中的索引。

items.source: Create a new Enhancer. A new Enhancer object should be used for each generated object, and should not be shared across threads. To create additional instances of a generated class, use the Factory interface.
items.translation: 创建一个新的Enhancer。每个生成的对象都应使用一个新的Enhancer 对象，且不应在不同线程之间共享。若要创建生成类的额外实例，请使用Factory接口。

items.source: Set whether the enhanced object instances should implement the Factory interface. This was added for tools that need for proxies to be more indistinguishable from their targets. Also, in some cases it may be necessary to disable the Factory interface to prevent code from changing the underlying callbacks.
items.translation: 设置是否让增强后的对象实例实现Factory接口。此功能是为需要代理与目标更加难以区分的工具而添加的。此外，在某些情况下，可能需要禁用Factory接口以防止代码更改底层回调。

items.source: This method should not be called in regular flow. Technically speaking wrapCachedClass(Class) uses Enhancer.EnhancerFactoryData as a cache value, and the latter enables faster instantiation than plain old reflection lookup and invoke. This method is left intact for backward compatibility reasons: just in case it was ever used.
items.translation: 此方法不应在常规流程中调用。从技术角度讲，wrapCachedClass(Class) 使用 Enhancer.EnhancerFactoryData 作为缓存值，后者比普通的反射查找和调用具有更快的实例化速度。出于向后兼容的原因，保留此方法：以防万一它曾被使用过。

items.source: Call this method to register the Callback array to use before creating a new instance of the generated class via reflection.
items.translation: 调用此方法注册 `Callback` 数组，以便在通过反射创建生成的类的新实例之前使用。

items.source: Similar to registerCallbacks(Class, Callback[]), but suitable for use when multiple threads will be creating instances of the generated class.
items.translation: 与registerCallbacks(Class, Callback[])类似，但适用于多个线程创建生成类实例的场景。

items.source: Set the single Callback to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的单个Callback。

items.source: Set the CallbackFilter used to map the generated class' methods to a particular callback index.
items.translation: 设置用于将生成的类的方法映射到特定回调索引的CallbackFilter。

items.translation: 设置要使用的单类型 `Callback`。

items.source: Set whether the enhanced object instances should implement the Factory interface.
items.translation: 设置是否让增强后的对象实例实现Factory接口。

items.source: Set the CallbackFilter used to map the generated class' methods to a particular callback index. New object instances will always use the same mapping, but may use different actual callback objects.
items.translation: 设置用于将生成的类的方法映射到特定回调索引的CallbackFilter。新对象实例将始终使用相同的映射，但可能使用不同的实际回调对象。

items.source: Similar to registerCallbacks(Class, Callback[]), but suitable for use when multiple threads will be creating instances of the generated class. The thread-level callbacks will always override the static callbacks. Static callbacks are never cleared.
items.translation: 类似于registerCallbacks(Class, Callback[])，但适用于多个线程创建生成类实例的场景。线程级回调将始终覆盖静态回调。静态回调永远不会被清除。

items.source: Determine if a class was generated using Enhancer.
items.translation: 确定类是否使用 `Enhancer` 生成。

items.source: Set the class which the generated class will extend. As a convenience, if the supplied superclass is actually an interface, setInterfaces will be called with the appropriate argument instead. A non-interface argument must not be declared as final, and must have an accessible constructor.
items.translation: 设置生成的类将扩展的类。作为一种便利，如果提供的超类实际上是一个接口，则会调用 setInterfaces 并传入适当的参数。非接口参数不得声明为 final，并且必须具有可访问的构造函数。

items.source: Set the interfaces to implement. The Factory interface will always be implemented regardless of what is specified here.
items.translation: 设置要实现的接口。无论此处指定什么，Factory 接口都将始终被实现。

items.source: Generate a new class if necessary and uses the specified callbacks (if any) to create a new object instance. Uses the constructor of the superclass matching the argumentTypes parameter, with the given arguments.
items.translation: 如有必要，则生成一个新类，并使用指定的回调（如果有）来创建一个新的对象实例。使用与 `argumentTypes` 参数匹配的超类构造函数，并传入给定的参数。

items.source: Generate a new class if necessary and return it without creating a new instance. This ignores any callbacks that have been set. To create a new instance you will have to use reflection, and methods called during the constructor will not be intercepted. To avoid this problem, use the multi-arg create method.
items.translation: 如有必要，生成一个新类并返回它，而无需创建新实例。 这会忽略任何已设置的回调。 若要创建新实例，您必须使用反射，且构造函数中调用的方法不会被拦截。为避免此问题，请使用多参数 create 方法。

items.source:

callbacks (if any) to create a new object instance.
items.translation: 必要时生成一个新类，并使用指定的回调（如有）来创建新的对象实例。

items.source: Insert a static serialVersionUID field into the generated class.
items.translation: 在生成的类中插入静态的 `serialVersionUID` 字段。

items.source:
Set whether methods called from within the proxy's constructer
will be intercepted. The default value is true. Unintercepted methods
will call the method of the proxy's base class, if it exists.
items.translation: 设置是否拦截在代理的构造函数中调用的方法。默认值为 true。未拦截的方法将调用代理基类中的相应方法（如果存在）。

items.source:
Generate a new class if necessary and uses the specified
callbacks (if any) to create a new object instance.
Uses the no-arg constructor of the superclass.
items.translation: 如有必要，生成一个新类并使用指定的回调（如果有）来创建新的对象实例。使用超类的无参构造函数。

items.source:
Finds all of the methods that will be extended by an
Enhancer-generated class using the specified superclass and
interfaces. This can be useful in building a list of Callback
objects. The methods are added to the end of the given list.  Due
to the subclassing nature of the classes generated by Enhancer,
the methods are guaranteed to be non-static, non-final, and
non-private. Each method signature will only occur once, even if
it occurs in multiple classes.
items.translation: 查找使用指定的父类和接口将由增强器生成的类扩展的所有方法。这在构建回调对象列表时可能很有用。这些方法将被添加到给定列表的末尾。由于增强器生成的类具有子类特性，因此保证这些方法是非静态、非最终且非私有的。即使某个方法签名在多个类中出现，它也只会添加一次。

items.source:
Filter the list of constructors from the superclass. The
constructors which remain will be included in the generated
class. The default implementation is to filter out all private
constructors, but subclasses may extend Enhancer to override this
behavior.
items.translation: 过滤来自超类的构造函数列表。保留的构造函数将被包含在生成的类中。默认实现是过滤掉所有私有构造函数，但子类可以扩展 Enhancer 来覆盖此行为。
